data.name: Freiman
data.long_meaning: Derived from the German word ‘fried’ meaning peace, and ‘man’ meaning warrior. This name signifies a peaceful warrior, someone who embodies the strength and courage of a warrior while maintaining a calm and peaceful demeanor.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek inner peace while also possessing a strong spirit and warrior mentality.
